C1090.title: Woman Sentenced for Running Mahjong Gambling via WeChat Group
C1090.summary: The defendant Liu created a WeChat group to recruit gamblers including Zhong and Gu to play mahjong through a mini-program, charging each participant a daily room fee of 3 to 5 yuan and collecting 29,641 yuan in total. The Xingguo County People's Court found that her conduct constituted operating a gambling venue, sentenced her to two years in prison and a 20,000 yuan fine, and ordered the confiscation of the returned illegal proceeds and seized phone.
